# How Manual Jobs Work in OrderHub Desktop

A **manual job** is a job whose artwork your staff uploaded in OrderHub, rather than artwork that came with an online order. Because nobody has cropped or checked that artwork yet, OrderHub Desktop treats manual jobs differently: it **never prints them automatically**, and every image must be approved before the job can be sent.

---

## From OrderHub to OrderHub Desktop

1. In OrderHub, upload the artwork to the job (see *Uploading Artwork to Manually Created Jobs*).
2. Click **Send to Production** (see *Sending Jobs to Production*).
3. OrderHub Desktop downloads the job the next time it checks for new work, the same as any other job.

* Note: Until you click **Send to Production**, OrderHub Desktop doesn't see the job at all.

---

## In the Jobs list

A manual job shows the **Manual — review required** label.

* **Auto Print skips it**, even when Auto Print is turned on for the controller.
* The **Process** button stays greyed out until every image has been approved. Hover over it to see "All frames must be approved before sending. Open Review to approve them."

![Manual Jobs Awaiting approval](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/257a6a40-d7ac-4c89-835f-445c1e67bf11.png)

* Note: A job from an online order that has an extra file uploaded by your staff counts as a manual job too.

---

## Reviewing and approving the images

1. Click **Review** on the job.
2. Job Review opens straight into cropping, one image at a time, at the job's print size.
3. For each image:
   * Drag the crop box into place. Use the rotate buttons, or the **Crop orientation** switch, if you need to.
   * Click **Approve + Next →** (or press **Enter**) to approve it and move on.
   * Click **Delete** to leave an image out of the job. Click **Restore** to bring it back.
4. Or click **Approve All** to approve every remaining image at once. Each image uses the crop you set, or is centred automatically at the print size if you didn't touch it.

![Image approval for manual jobs](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/784bed6f-ab33-4477-b30c-96841ee7c5a7.png)

* Note: If you close Job Review part-way through, the job remembers what you've done. Next time it shows **Batch Crop Remaining (X of Y)** to carry on.

---

## Sending the job

Once every image is approved (deleted images don't count):

* click **Send to Print** in Job Review, or
* click **Process** on the job in the Jobs list.

The job is then marked **In Production**. Complete it in OrderHub once it's printed.

* Note: If every image has been deleted, Job Review shows "All images discarded — nothing to print" and the job can't be sent.

---

## Good to know

* **Why the approval step?** Without it, an image you'd cropped but not approved would print uncropped. Approving is what tells OrderHub Desktop to use your crop.
* **Changed your mind after approving?** Edit the crop and approve it again. An image with unapproved changes blocks sending until you do.
* **Need more files?** Upload them in OrderHub before you click **Send to Production**. Once a job has been sent to production, its uploads are locked.
